requirements_summary: Workload: inbound customer support + knowledge base search (doc-search), occasional reranking for suggested replies
Traffic profile: baseline 5-10 requests/sec; marketing campaigns produce bursts up to 80-120 req/sec for 3-10 minutes
Latency target: p95 generation <350ms for single-turn support responses
Throughput target: sustain 40 req/sec steady for paid tier, allow short bursts to 120 req/sec
Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious; want unit economics and estimates for burst pricing
Rate-limiting needs: per-account concurrency cap, per-minute token quotas, per-second rate limits, burst allowance window
Desired 429 behavior: explicit Retry-After header, documented client retry guidance (exponential backoff with jitter), graceful degrade to cached answer or lower-cost model when possible
Monitoring: per-tenant 429 counts, throttled request logging, SLA alerts for spikes
Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to smaller model variant rather than failing the request
Security: hosted public cloud acceptable; still require audit logs and SSO onboarding later
